summary.text: Ralph Massullo represents District 11 in the Florida Senate, elected on December 9, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Massullo previously served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2024.
Massullo is a physician born in Morgantown, West Virginia, who moved to Florida in 1990 and holds an industrial engineering degree and a medical degree from West Virginia University.
